description: Immutable-identity app-factory or optimization rollout. External artifacts and OTel traces are referenced by content hash.
name: factory_episode

description: Bounded, evidence-backed proposal. The optimizer may propose a candidate but cannot alter verifier, reward, promotion, or production authority.
name: factory_evolution_proposal

description: Independent signed promotion outcome with evidence and an explicit rollback target.
name: factory_promotion_decision

description: Append-only, redacted copy of Eve root-agent durable stream events. Eve event ids provide idempotency; session ids bind events to factory episodes.
name: factory_runtime_event

description: Evolving application-domain lookup. Not a Postgres enum.
name: research_application_domain

description: Per-version definitions for the stable engineering category enum.
name: research_category_definition

description: One claimable orchestration row per video+transcript-hash attempt.
name: research_pre_research_run

description: Raw AI Engineer channel catalog plus transcript storage pointers. Starter table for the research schema; relationship tables come later.
name: research_starter_videos

description: Versioned AI engineering taxonomy. Exactly one row may be active.
name: research_taxonomy_version

description: Immutable analysis packet for one completed pre-research run.
name: research_video_analysis

description: Exactly one primary category and up to three secondary categories per analysis.
name: research_video_category

description: Append-only cross-agent progress ledger. Lease state remains on work_item; every transition and checkpoint is recorded here.
name: work_item_event

description: Merge history for canonical entities. The review that authorized a merge is found through evaluation.review_task.entity_merge_id, never by a column here -- corpus must not reference evaluation.
name: entity_merge
